label: Gmail
terms_note: Automation allowed through OAuth 2.0 on the user's own mailbox. gmail.send is a SENSITIVE scope (OAuth app verification); gmail.readonly / gmail.modify / gmail.compose / mail.google.com are RESTRICTED scopes — restricted-scope verification plus a security assessment when restricted data is stored or transmitted on servers (a tenant's own Cloud project in testing / internal mode is exempt). Quota: 1,200,000 quota units/min per project, 6,000 units/min per user per project; messages.send = 100 units, messages.get = 20, messages.list = 5, history.list = 2, watch = 100; 500 recipients per message; 80,000,000 units/day billing threshold later in 2026. Push watch must be renewed at least every 7 days.

sdks: Google API client libraries — JavaScript, Java, Python, Apps Script, Go, Node.js quickstarts (developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides)

auth: 1. Tenant's (or the platform's) Cloud project → OAuth 2.0 client (web) → consent screen.
2. Authorization-code flow with `access_type=offline` → refresh token stored by the suite (secrets stay in `messaging_db`).

endpoints.notes: body `{raw: base64url(RFC 822), threadId?}`; set `In-Reply-To` / `References` in the MIME for threading; 100 quota units
list 5 units, get 20 units; `format=metadata` for headers only
Cloud Pub/Sub topic; grant `gmail-api-push@system.gserviceaccount.com` publish; renew **at least every 7 days**; notification = `{emailAddress, historyId}` → `history.list`
draft the proposal, send on approval

reference.limits: - Quota (developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/quota): **1,200,000 units/min per project**, **6,000 units/min per user per project**, 500 recipients per message; 80,000,000 units/day billing threshold later in 2026; new projects after 2026-05-01 get the new quotas. - Sending caps are account-level (Workspace daily limits), not API-level. No native templates, analytics or unsubscribe endpoints — the suite adds `List-Unsubscribe` / `List-Unsubscribe-Post` (RFC 8058) itself. - Automation of the user's own mailbox is allowed; the consent screen + verification tier is the only gate

adapter.rate_note: Per-user quota 15,000 units per minute; messages.list 5 units, threads.get 10, messages.modify 5 (https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/quota).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console, Clients page) of the app the user consented to.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The OAuth client's secret; sent with client_id, refresh_token and grant_type=refresh_token in the form body of POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token (https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/web-server#offline).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent with access_type=offline and the scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify (or gmail.readonly for reading only). 'Refresh tokens are valid until the user revokes access or the refresh token expires'; the runtime mints 1-hour access tokens from it.

me.note: users.getProfile: account carries emailAddress, messagesTotal, threadsTotal, historyId.

list_inbound.note: users.messages.list with labelIds=INBOX: 'each message resource contains only an id and a threadId' — read the text with get_thread. Gmail pages by pageToken, so `page` is ignored (first `limit` messages only); `since` is not sent; total is Gmail's resultSizeEstimate.

get_thread.note: users.threads.get?format=metadata: every message of the thread with `snippet` ('a short part of the message text') as text and internalDate (epoch milliseconds) as sent_at; From/To/Subject are in raw.payload.headers. `page`/`limit` are ignored (the whole thread is returned).

mark_read.note: users.messages.modify with removeLabelIds ["UNREAD"]; `message_id` is required, `thread_id` and `channel` are not used.

not_offered.send: users.messages.send takes a Message whose `raw` is 'The entire email message in an RFC 2822 formatted and base64url encoded string' — 'Gmail messages are sent as base64URL encoded strings within the raw field' (https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending); the docs offer no JSON alternative and the adapter contract has no MIME/base64url encoding expression.
not_offered.reply: Replies are also users.messages.send with a base64url RFC 2822 `raw` body plus threadId and matching References/In-Reply-To headers (https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending); not expressible without a MIME encoding expression.
